pcb_footprint.note: Nologo 16-pin carrier interface; 15.24 mm rows / 2.54 mm pitch. parameters.Description: Nologo ESP32-C3 SuperMini module, two 1x8 carrier headers, GPIO6 TX / GPIO7 RX
parameters.Footprint Status: Nologo source-based header pin geometry. Local model assumes 3.1 mm underside clearance and 7.2 mm total height; no separate socket part is specified.

notes: Compact routed engineering prototype; electrical/thermal qualification and final component release remain pending.
GND_BUS and GND_LOGIC stay separated by at least 3.8 mm of copper-free carrier area.
U2 needs >=9V at its input after protection/filter losses; start-up at exactly 9V NET-S is not guaranteed.
Open JP1 BEFORE connecting USB; close JP1 only with USB disconnected.
Direct-soldered module headers; module underside 3.1 mm above carrier. No carrier copper below antenna.
Mechanical models are local envelope approximations, not manufacturer STEP models.
pcb_review_note: Compact routed engineering prototype. Verify thermal behavior and actual module before production.
